dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric, gradual reduction in lateral width from the pectoral insertion region towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetric with no observed bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water surface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity reflectance across the entire visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark oval at the anterior cephalic midline (blowhole); faint, low-contrast longitudinal greyish line along the posterior dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear shadow-casting feature along the mid-sagittal axis of the posterior third of the body, indicating a raised dorsal ridge.
